node.data.join.name: Join collections
node.data.join.description: Join two arrays by a comparison of selected keys. Keep matching rows or explicitly include unmatched rows.
node.data.group.name: Group collection
node.data.group.description: Group by a JSON path, preserving the order of keys and items. Missing keys and null form the same group.
node.data.flatten.name: Flatten arrays
node.data.flatten.description: Flatten nested arrays to the selected depth while keeping scalars and null.
node.data.expand.name: Expand array field
node.data.expand.description: Create a row for each array field element, preserving the other object fields.
node.data.split.name: Split by condition
node.data.split.description: Split items into matched, rejected and indeterminate arrays without converting incompatible values.
setting.keepEmpty: Keep rows with an empty array
port.data.split.out.indeterminate: Items that could not be compared
